prompts.title: The "STILL" Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, high-fashion editorial portrait of a handsome man. Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face matching and identity reference.
Composition: Center-framed, medium portrait shot from the lower chest up. The layout is balanced and highly symmetrical, resembling a movie poster or a high-end magazine cover. Above the subject's head, centered in the upper third of the image, the word "STILL" is written in large, expressive, sweeping, hand-painted brushstroke typography using a muted, lighter sky-blue tone.
Outfit: He is wearing a sophisticated, layered winter wardrobe. The base is a thick, dark navy-blue knit turtleneck sweater. Over this, he wears a heavy, tailored, dark charcoal-grey or black wool overcoat with classic notched lapels. The textures of the wool and knit fabric are highly detailed.
Pose: He stands with his arms tightly and confidently folded across his chest. His posture is rigid and upright, creating a subtly dominant and commanding presence.
Expression: His expression is intense, stoic, and serious. He exudes quiet confidence and authority, with a piercing, unwavering gaze directed slightly downward at the viewer.
Background: A solid, flat, deep navy-blue studio backdrop with no gradients or distracting elements, isolating the subject and contrasting strictly with the lighter blue text above him.
Lighting: Dramatic, moody, low-key studio lighting. A strong key light is positioned front and slightly above, highlighting the texture in his hair, the bridge of his nose, and his cheekbones. It casts sharp, defined shadows beneath his nose, and brow ridge, adding depth and masculine ruggedness to his features.
Camera Angle: A subtle low angle, shooting slightly upward at the subject. This reinforces the imposing, powerful, and larger-than-life feel of the portrait.
Technical Details: Shot on 85mm lens, f/2, sharp depth of field across the subject and the text. Medium format photography, Hasselblad style. 8k resolution, photorealistic, ultra-detailed fabric, smooth skin, cinematic color grading with a highly restricted, monochromatic cool color palette dominated by deep blues, navy, and charcoal tones. High contrast between the highlights on his face and the dark clothing. aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Red Alert
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-fashion editorial portrait of a stylish woman sitting cross-legged inside a small, box-shaped room completely covered with black-and-white newspaper pages on the walls, floor, and ceiling. The environment feels conceptual, artistic, and slightly claustrophobic, like a modern art installation.

The woman is centered in the frame, facing the camera with a surprised, expressive look, both hands pressed gently against her cheeks. She is wearing bold red pants, red low-top canvas sneakers with white rubber soles and laces, and bright red cat-eye sunglasses. The vibrant red accessories create a strong contrast against the monochrome newspaper environment.

Her outfit includes a black top layered with a black-and-white small-check patterned blazer, creating a modern editorial fashion look. Her hair is a sleek, natural-length dark bob, styled naturally.

Face matching: Match the face to the uploaded reference image, preserving identity, facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, and expression accuracy. Maintain strong facial realism and clarity consistent with professional editorial photography.

Pose: Sitting cross-legged on the newspaper-covered floor, torso upright and centered, elbows bent outward, both hands touching the face, symmetrical posture, direct eye-line toward the camera.

Lighting: Soft frontal studio key light centered on the face, subtle overhead fill light, evenly illuminated newspaper walls, soft shadows beneath the legs, gentle shadow gradient in the corners of the room. Clean editorial lighting that highlights facial expression, clothing texture, and newspaper print detail without harsh contrast.

Ultra-detailed 4K resolution, highly realistic skin texture, crisp fabric detail, and sharp newspaper typography. Professional studio fashion photography, editorial magazine style, modern avant-garde aesthetic, clean framing, premium quality.

Aspect ratio: 4:5 (vertical portrait).
